Definition: middle voice from G4314 and G2564; to call toward oneself, i.e. summon, invite:--call (for, to, unto).
BiblicalUsage: Proskaleomai means to call to oneself, to summon, to invite near. Jesus called unto Him whom He would, and they came unto Him. Peter says the promise is to as many as the Lord our God shall call, and James says to call for the elders of the church to pray over the sick.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the call of God is personal: He calls whom He will, and the ones He calls come.
